text_en: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, observe carefully what is before you,
text_cn: 几时你与首长坐席，应记着，在你面前的是谁。

text_en: and put a knife to your throat if you have a big appetite.
text_cn: 你若过于贪食，应在咽喉上，放上一把刀。

text_en: Do not desire the ruler’s delicacies, for they are deceptive food.
text_cn: 休要羡慕他的珍馐，因那是骗人的食品。

text_en: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; be wise enough to desist.
text_cn: 不要辛苦企求致富，反应放弃这种企图。

text_en: When your eyes light upon it, it is gone; for suddenly it takes wings to itself, flying like an eagle toward heaven.
text_cn: 你向之一注目，即不再存在了：它会生出翅膀，如鹰向天飞去。

text_en: Do not eat the bread of the stingy; do not desire their delicacies;
text_cn: 不要与虎视眈眈的人进食，也不要羡慕他的山珍海味，

text_en: for like a hair in the throat, so are they. “Eat and drink! ” they say to you; but they do not mean it.
text_cn: 因为他原是只顾自己的人，他口头虽对你说“请吃请喝！”但他的心中并不与你友善；

text_en: You will vomit up the little you have eaten, and you will waste your pleasant words.
text_cn: 你吃下的那口食物，还得吐出；你婉转悦耳的言辞，尽属枉费。

text_en: Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, who will only despise the wisdom of your words.
text_cn: 不要与愚人交耳接谈，因他必轻视你的高见。

text_en: Do not remove an ancient landmark or encroach on the fields of orphans,
text_cn: 不要移动孀妇的地界，不要侵占孤儿的田地；

text_en: for their redeemer is strong; he will plead their cause against you.
text_cn: 因为他们的辩护者是大能的，他必为他们的案件与你争辩。

text_en: Apply your mind to instruction and your ear to words of knowledge.
text_cn: 你应专心接受教训，倾耳细听益智之言。

text_en: Do not withhold discipline from your children; if you beat them with a rod, they will not die.
text_cn: 对孩童不可忽略惩戒；用棍打他，他不致死去。

text_en: If you beat them with the rod, you will save their lives from Sheol.
text_cn: 你用棍杖打他，是救他的灵魂免下阴府。

text_en: My child, if your heart is wise, my heart too will be glad.
text_cn: 我儿，你若心怀智慧，我也诚心喜乐；

text_en: My soul will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
text_cn: 你的唇舌若谈吐正义的事，我的五衷也必会踊跃欢欣。

text_en: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the Lord .
text_cn: 心里不要羡慕罪人，却要日日敬畏上主；

text_en: Surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
text_cn: 这样，你的将来必然顺利，你的希望绝不落空。

text_en: Hear, my child, and be wise, and direct your mind in the way.
text_cn: 我儿，你要听话，作个明智人；且要引领你的心走上正道。

text_en: Do not be among winebibbers, or among gluttonous eaters of meat;
text_cn: 贪嗜酒肉的人，不可与之来往；

text_en: for the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and drowsiness will clothe them with rags.
text_cn: 因为嗜酒贪食的人，必陷于穷困；贪懒好睡的人，必衣着褴褛。

text_en: Listen to your father who begot you, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
text_cn: 对生养你的父亲，应当听从；对你年迈的母亲，不可轻视。

text_en: Buy truth, and do not sell it; buy wisdom, instruction, and understanding.
text_cn: 应获取真理，不可出卖，还有智慧、训诲和见识。

text_en: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; he who begets a wise son will be glad in him.
text_cn: 义人的父亲，必欣然喜乐；生育慧子的，必为此欢腾。

text_en: Let your father and mother be glad; let her who bore you rejoice.
text_cn: 应使你的父亲因你而喜悦，应使你的生母因你而快乐。

text_en: My child, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my ways.
text_cn: 我儿，将你的心交给我，注目于我的道路：

text_en: For a prostitute is a deep pit; an adulteress is a narrow well.
text_cn: 妓女是一个深坑，淫妇是一个陷阱；

text_en: She lies in wait like a robber and increases the number of the faithless.
text_cn: 她潜伏着，实如强盗，使人世间，增添奸夫。

text_en: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaining? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?
text_cn: 是谁将哀鸣，是谁将悲叹？是谁将争吵，是谁将抱怨？是谁将无故受伤，是谁将双目赤红？

text_en: Those who linger late over wine, those who keep trying mixed wines.
text_cn: 是那流连于醉乡，去搜求醇酒的人。

text_en: Do not look at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
text_cn: 你不要注视酒色怎样红，在杯中怎样闪耀，饮下去怎样痛快！

text_en: At the last it bites like a serpent, and stings like an adder.
text_cn: 终究它要咬人如蛇，刺人如虺（huǐ）。

text_en: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind utter perverse things.
text_cn: 那时，你的眼要见到奇景，你的心要吐出狂语。

text_en: You will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, like one who lies on the top of a mast.
text_cn: 你宛如躺在海中心，睡在桅杆顶。

text_en: “They struck me, ” you will say, “but I was not hurt; they beat me, but I did not feel it. When shall I awake? I will seek another drink. ”
text_cn: “人打我，我不痛，人捶我，我不觉；我何时苏醒，好再去寻醉！”
